description: trip1 lets agents search, compare and book real hotel inventory — roughly 3 million properties in 200+ countries. Search by destination and dates, inspect rooms, rates and cancellation terms, then create a reservation and pay in USDC on Base over x402 (or via a browser-based crypto checkout). Bookings confirm automatically once payment settles.
